test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The speaker __is about to beginner__ his speech.
solution:
The correct answer is **"is about to begin"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Basically the verb of the sentence is wrong which is underlined. **Beginner** is not a verb.As part of the infinitive form, the word **"to"** usually goes with a verb rather than a **noun .**
 
• We have to use the original form of verb after **"to"**.

So the sentence will be **The speaker is about to begin____ __****his speech**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• According to English Grammar, **past form** should not be sir after **"to"**. Therefore, the first option is incorrect because **"began"** is the past form of **"begin"**.
 
• **Beginner** is not a verb.So the second option is **incorrect**.
 
• **Beginning** is the present continuous form of the verb which should not be used after **"to"**.
